data.one_liner: Generates ASCII art from images, FIGlet text banners, Unicode fonts, and emoticons.
data.what_it_does: Generates ASCII art using image-to-ASCII conversion, FIGlet text banner rendering, Unicode font styling, and emoticon-to-text conversion. It processes Dart image objects and text strings into stylized text representations.
use_when: You need to convert images into textual ASCII art representations
You want to render FIGlet text banners in your Dart application
You need to convert normal text into Unicode alternate font styles like doublestruck
avoid_when: You need advanced image editing or multi-color ASCII output (images are always converted to grayscale)
You need right-to-left text direction support for FIGlet banners
strengths: Supports multiple features including images, FIGlet, Unicode fonts, and emoticons
Compatible across Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Images are always converted to grayscale
FIGlet banners are only supported with left-to-right text direction and are not automatically wrapped into multiple lines
Cannot programmatically list available FIGlet fonts; you must know their names
data.setup_notes: Just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import it.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides core image decoding and manipulation capabilities if you only need lower-level image processing.
